format: SharkPort save ("SharkPortSave", kind 0x000F0000): title "POKEMON SAPP", date "Save5/8/2004 12:00:28 AM 41", notes ""; cart header "POKEMON SAPP" / 'AXPE' (complement 0x55); payload 65536 bytes; checksum: unsigned
